desc:
🃏 Welcome to My Trading Card Shop! 🃏

Open Anime, Football, Soccer, Critimon, Basketball, Brainrot, or Baseball packs, pull rare cards and build the best card shop in town!

⚠️ This game is still in development! Please let me know of any bugs you encouter via the Feedback Mailbox, thank you!

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT IS LIVE NOW! UNTIL NOV 4TH!

💰 RUN YOUR SHOP WITH YOUR FRIENDS: Stock the shelves, set your prices and ring up customers at the till. Show off your best pulls and sell them!

👥 HIRE STAFF: Workers stock, sell and promote your shop while you chase the big pulls.

🏆 COLLECT AND TRADE: Fill your album, grade your best cards, trade with other players and climb the leaderboards.

🔨 BUILD YOUR WAY: Grow your store and decorate it to your ultimate shop!

🎁 Daily rewards, plus 10% extra cash on sales when you play with friends!

⚡ Use code BETA for free rewards!

👍 Like and favorite for updates!
